title: Stereo field
description: A stereo vector plot connects phase and width controls to a continuous trace and correlation meter.
useCase: Make mid/side stereo relationships visible in an audio control or signal-inspection tool.
interaction: Adjust phase and width, inspect correlation, and pause or resume the trace.
reducedMotion: The phase relationship remains visible as a static vector plot; controls still update the shape and correlation immediately.
limitations: Synthetic two-channel sine signal only, with no audio capture or playback. Correlation describes the generated signal, not a connected audio source; a silent mid/side result reads zero.
look: Pale blue-grey instrument card: a circular scope of rings, ticks and dashed axes with a violet ellipse, beside two sliders, monospace readouts and a meter.
motion: A dark dot travels the violet Lissajous trace continuously (about 3.8 s per lap); phase and width sliders reshape the ellipse and move the correlation needle instantly.
adapt: `signalPath` builds the trace from `phase` and `width`, `correlation` drives the meter, and the `tick` loop moves the `dot` at the `1.65` rate. Feed real left/right samples into `signalPath` instead of the synthetic `Math.sin` pair.
